text: Do not put a small model in front of an agentic model on the strength of a system prompt. Measured 2026-11-17: ikabud:coder (qwen2.5-coder:1.5b + 8 approved lessons in SYSTEM) answered 'yes you can claim it works' to a question its own embedded rule forbids, and picked the wrong rule (3 of 8) when asked to select one. The deterministic FTS5 retriever returned the correct lesson at rank 1 on the same brief. Prove recall against the deterministic control before wiring any model into a prompt path.
